description: Replace Stub Implementations with Real Ones — Replace StubAiClient with OpenAI-compatible client, InMemoryStore with IndexedDB, and StubPdfBridge with real WASM PDF extraction so the product actually works end-to-end.

userStories.title: Replace StubAiClient with OpenAI-compatible real AI client
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the gateway to call a real OpenAI-compatible LLM API instead of returning canned stub responses.
acceptanceCriteria: Add reqwest dependency to crates/gateway/Cargo.toml (already present as dev-dep, move to regular dep)
Implement OpenAiClient struct that reads GATEWAY_AI_BASE_URL and GATEWAY_AI_API_KEY from env
OpenAiClient implements AiClient trait, calling POST {base_url}/chat/completions with system prompt for translation/explanation
Parse OpenAI chat completion response JSON into ExplainResult and translation String
crates/gateway/src/main.rs uses OpenAiClient instead of StubAiClient
GATEWAY_AI_API_KEY or GATEWAY_AI_TOKEN required; gateway exits early with clear error if neither is set
Fallback to StubAiClient when GATEWAY_AI_USE_STUB=true for dev convenience
docs/runtime-config.md updated with new env vars
Existing gateway_translate_contract and gateway_explain_contract tests continue to pass (they still use StubAiClient via a test constructor)
cargo test --test gateway_translate_contract passes
cargo test --test gateway_explain_contract passes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add real IndexedDB storage backend for browser
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the web app to persist data in browser IndexedDB instead of the InMemoryStore so data survives page reloads.
acceptanceCriteria: Add indexed_db_store.rs module under crates/web-app/src/storage/
IndexedDbStore struct wraps web_sys::IdbDatabase with async API mirroring AppStorage trait
On construction, opens/create an IndexedDB database with object stores for papers, blocks, progress, annotations, vocabulary, ai_records, and settings
All storage operations implemented with IndexedDB transactions
Vocabulary upsert uses IndexedDB index on term_lower field to find existing entry and increment lookup_count
Module cfg-gated for wasm32 target; InMemoryStore remains for native testing
cargo test --test web_storage_round_trip passes (uses InMemoryStore on native)
cargo test --test web_vocabulary_round_trip passes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: IndexedDbStore cfg-gated for wasm32. WASM build blocked by importing crate pulling in pdf-extract (not WASM-compatible). Requires separate refactor to make importing dependency optional for wasm target.

userStories.title: Add real WASM-based PDF text extraction via vendored pdf.js
userStories.description: As a developer, I need real PDF text extraction in the browser using pdf.js, replacing StubPdfBridge.
acceptanceCriteria: Add WasmPdfBridge struct that implements PdfTextBridge trait
Vendored pdf.js assets under crates/web-app/assets/pdfjs/ (already scaffolded with README)
Bridge calls global pdfjs_extract_text() JS function loaded from vendored pdf.js
Handle extraction errors: ExtractionFailed and NoTextFound
StubPdfBridge remains for native testing (no cfg needed)
cargo test --test web_import_pdf_flow passes (uses StubPdfBridge on native)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: WasmPdfBridge cfg-gated for wasm32. Delegates to pdfjs_extract_text() global JS function. pdf.js library must be loaded separately in the browser HTML.

userStories.title: Add real request-based WebAiClient for browser
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the browser web-app AiClient to actually call the gateway over HTTP instead of using canned responses.
acceptanceCriteria: Add GatewayAiClient struct in crates/web-app/src/ai/client.rs
GatewayAiClient posts to gateway /api/translate and /api/explain endpoints via gloo-net
Gateway base URL configurable (default: http://localhost:3000)
Async translate_async and explain_async methods for WASM context
Existing WebAiClient path remains for native testing
cargo test --test web_selection_translate_flow passes
cargo test --test web_ai_offline_state passes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: GatewayAiClient cfg-gated for wasm32. Uses gloo-net::http::Request for async HTTP. Native testing uses existing WebAiClient. Browser verification pending - needs running gateway and trunk serve.
